The visual structure matches the taxonomy (rim, tire, spokes, hub). However, the alignment is not perfect (5.0) because the functional components (lug nuts) lack realistic mechanical detail, and the central sticker is nonsensical, which detracts from the 'functional' aspect of the class definition.
artifact_reasoning: The primary defect is the text gibberish on the center sticker, a classic AI artifact. Secondary defects include the 'muddy' texture of the lug nut holes (lacking machined metal realism) and slight softness/blending at the spoke-rim junctions. The perceptual_quality_auditor noted slight darkening/shadowing issues. These artifacts prevent a high artifact score, placing it in the 'noticeable but not catastrophic' range (similar to Reference 2's artifact level, though perhaps slightly better structured).
